newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P rates Westpac NZ's 350 mln mark FRN AA-minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Westpac NZ's 350 mln mark FRN AA-minus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said it has assigned it AA-minus long term debt rating to Westpac Banking Corp New Zealand branch's 350 million mark floating rate note issue, maturing June 4, 1999.
The rating reflects the AA minus long term counterparty rating assigned to Westpac, while the rating outlook is stable, the rating agency said.
"The outlook reflects Standard & Poor's expectation that Westpac will continue to be a strong contender in the Australasian banking environment," it said.

"While future asset quality may fluctuate in line with economic cycles of Australian and New Zealand, the profit and loss impact will be mitigated by Westpac's credit control systems and conservative provisioning polices," S&P added.
